== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|The [[Karoshan]] fleet is a military force composed of various vessel classes, including thousands of small and medium ships, several dozen larger vessels, and a significant number of starfighters. The fleet's aesthetic is characterized by black, blocky designs, though some ships appear as dark-metal birds or feature organic shapes with blue-green glowing seams. A primary component of their naval power is a massive, six-mile-long dreadnought flagship that serves as a devastating engine of [[destruction]]. Many vessels within the fleet contain golden spots and are piloted by mass-produced [[Nova-Bots]]. The fleet's composition and allegiances vary depending on the faction in control. Forces sent by [[King Regent|King Regent Felrex]] consist of black, blocky ships, while an exiled [[Queen]] leads a separate rebel fleet. These [[Karoshan forces]] have been utilized for various tactical roles, such as establishing military blockades, screening weaker vessels, and acting as a defensive wedge to absorb pressure from opposing militaries. While the fleet has engaged in planetary invasions and large-[[scale]] system-wide combat, they have also been known to prioritize withdrawal over standing their ground in certain engagements.}}
